title: Google Sheet Source Entry
description: Minimal, additive extension of a client's sources.json (clients/<client_id>/sources.json, private workspace): one entry of type google_sheet. Other source types keep their existing free-form shape — only entries with type=google_sheet are validated against this contract. The spreadsheet id is the only locator; names are never searched. Real ids live only in the private workspace, never in the public engine.

location.description: Optional human hint, kept for compatibility with other source entries. Never used to resolve the spreadsheet — google_sheet.spreadsheet_id is.

contains_multiple_clients.description: true forbids writes by update-google-sheet and makes read-google-sheet warn.

expected_title.description: When set, a spreadsheet whose title differs is treated as WRONG_SPREADSHEET.

purpose.description: Free label (e.g. metrics, playbook, account_plan). Informational only — never drives business logic in the transport or ACTION.

allowed_tabs.description: Optional allowlist of tab titles. null = any tab.

writable.description: Must be true for update-google-sheet to preview/apply against this spreadsheet.
